chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
When you have finished the prayer, turn away to your right.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended direction to turn after finishing the prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi specifies the physical direction of the final salutation (Taslim) in prayer, emphasizing a turn to the right as the normative practice (Sunnah) of the Prophet and the Imams. It reflects the Shia emphasis on precise ritual etiquette (Adab) in worship, distinguishing the complete form of prayer as transmitted through the Ahl al-Bayt. This instruction underscores the continuity between the Prophet's practice and the Imams' teachings regarding the physical execution of Salat.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Usman Bin Isa, from Sama’at, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When you exit from the Salāt, so exit from your right’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from Sama‘ah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
When you want to move away after completing Salah (prayer) move to your right side.”’
